name: dli-nxs-wd-approx
title: DLI NXS, WD optic (approximation)
source: Generic batwing (150 deg, p = 2.5) calibrated on a production AGi32 report that used the NXS WD optic: -1 % on the average
notes: The real MW file is much narrower: with it, one fixture at 4 ft already gives 217 umol at nadir, above the 208 maximum of the 36-fixture reference. Use this curve for projects specified with the WD optic until the DLI WD file is available.
